description: A Chilean two-year professional-development programme run for prekindergarten and kindergarten teachers and aides, combining didactic workshops, coaching, classroom observation, school-based reflection, and early-childhood learning resources.
title: Un Buen Comienzo (UBC) professional development program

description: understAID is an ICT-based e-learning platform developed to support informal dementia caregivers through structured information, daily-care tools, personalization, and moderated social networking.
title: understAID

description: A curriculum-design framework developed by Grant Wiggins and Jay McTighe that guides educators to plan from desired results through evidence and learning experiences.
title: Understanding by Design (UbD) backward design framework

description: Underwater is a serious video game by Sfinx Games that uses a 3D-printed ultrasound-probe controller and playful object-finding tasks to train probe manipulation and basic ultrasound image acquisition.
title: Underwater

description: A UNESCO framework that organizes 12 AI competencies for school students into four dimensions: human-centred mindset, ethics of AI, AI techniques and applications, and AI system design.
title: UNESCO AI Competency Framework for School Students

description: A UNESCO framework specifying 15 AI-related teacher competencies across five dimensions to guide national competency frameworks and teacher training programmes.
title: UNESCO AI Competency Framework for Teachers

description: A UNESCO global standard-setting framework that provides ethical principles and policy guidance for governments, educators, learners, and other stakeholders implementing and governing artificial intelligence.
title: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence

description: A UNESCO framework for evaluating whether generative-AI policies address ethical governance, inclusion, equity, access, gender, sustainability, and related responsible-use considerations in education.
title: UNESCO's eight-component GenAI framework

description: UniDental-MU01 is a computer-based virtual simulation system made by UNIDRAW, China, for interactive preclinical dental preparation training with automated scoring and recorded practice.
title: UniDental-MU01 virtual simulation system

description: A school-administered standardized mathematics achievement test developed with professional assistance from the Education Bureau of Yudu and scored using unified answer keys and procedures.
title: Unified standardized mathematics test designed with the Education Bureau of Yudu

description: UNIPS is a Finnish national online platform developed collaboratively by eight universities to provide self-study and guided short modules in university pedagogy for university staff and doctoral students.
title: UNIPS

description: UNITE is a unified e-learning environment and associated cross-curricular learning scenarios developed by the FP6 IST UNITE project for school use.
title: UNITE e-Learning platform and learning scenarios

description: Units of Sound is a computer-based structured, cumulative, multisensory reading and spelling programme developed by Dyslexia Action for struggling readers.
title: Units of Sound

description: CAST's framework for designing flexible instruction around learner variability through multiple means of Engagement, Representation, and Action & Expression.
title: Universal Design for Learning (UDL) framework

description: A 30-item self-report screening questionnaire developed by Tindle et al.
title: University Needs Instrument (UNI)

description: A UCF Center for Community Schools certification and technical-assistance programme that helps Florida schools implement and demonstrate fidelity to the Community Partnership Schools model through standards, self-assessment, coaching, mentoring, and external review.
title: University of Central Florida Center for Community Schools certification system for the Community Partnership Schools model

description: An anonymised dataset of online student teaching evaluations linked to course, teacher, and final-mark records, released with microdata and Stata analysis code by the University of Girona study authors via Dryad.
title: University of Girona teaching-evaluation dataset (86,038 student records, 2014–2016)

description: A University of Leeds web platform that provides pathology students and professionals with searchable access to a large library of whole-slide images and pathological cases for self-directed study and review.
title: University of Leeds Virtual Pathology website

description: A six-point, 13-item tutor rating scale developed and used by the University of the West Indies to assess medical students’ participation, problem-solving, self-directed learning, critical-thinking, and teamwork in PBL tutorials.
title: University of the West Indies PBL tutorial assessment rating scale

description: A seven-competency, four-level proficiency framework developed by the University of Virginia Partnership for Leaders in Education to assess and develop school leaders in turnaround contexts.
title: University of Virginia Partnership for Leaders in Education turnaround competency model

description: A simulated electronic patient-record system created with an EPR system provider for academic institutions to teach healthcare students to use EPRs without access to live systems.
title: University simulation EPR

description: UNITSS is a Likert-scale self-report instrument developed by Douwes-van Ark et al.
title: UNIversity Teaching Self-Efficacy Scale (UNITSS)

description: UNyDIET is a nutrition-assessment software system with embedded learning-oriented computer-assisted instruction for clinical students and health professionals, developed by García de Diego and colleagues.
title: UNyDIET learning-oriented CAI
